summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K with summarized minutes of its Board of Directors meeting held August 4, 2026. The Board approved the January–June 2026 financial statements, authorized their submission to regulators, and approved payment of interest on capital. The gross amount is R$0.71076 per share, net R$0.586377, payable August 28, 2026. This is a routine periodic disclosure involving standard dividend-like distributions and financial statement approvals, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or other event-driven category applies.
